tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. ch7:7.4For a Riemannian or pseudo-Riemannian manifold, the components of the $(1,3)$-curvature tensor in any smooth coordinates are \begin{equation} R_{ijk}^l =\partial _i\Gamma _{jk}^l-\partial _j\Gamma _{ik}^l +\Gamma _{jk}^m\Gamma _{im}^l-\Gamma _{ik}^m\Gamma _{jm}^l. \tag {7.4} \end{equation}

Let $\Gamma \colon J\times I\to M$ be a smooth family of curves. Write $\partial _t\Gamma $ and $\partial _s\Gamma $ for its two velocity fields and $D_t,D_s$ for the associated covariant derivatives along $\Gamma $.
